mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in FEDFUNDS signals monetary easing, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in >50% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly UNRATE increase exceeding 5.0% triggers economic weakness signals, causing immediate equity market sell-offs and negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in >60% of months when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous HOUST and RSAFS declines exceeding 0.5% in the prior month indicate weakening consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST decline > 0.5% and RSAFS decline > 0.5% in prior month
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in >50% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline >0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: INDPRO below 95.0 signals manufacturing slowdown, reducing corporate earnings growth expectations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of periods when INDPRO < 95.0.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL year-over-year increase exceeding 3.0% signals inflationary pressure, triggering central bank rate hikes that cause negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in >55% of months when CPIAUCSL yoy > 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month PAYEMS increase signals labor market strength, boosting consumer spending and corporate profits to produce positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in >50% of periods when PAYEMS increases for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous FEDFUNDS rise >0.25% and CPIAUCSL yoy >2.5% signal aggressive monetary tightening, reducing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in >50% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises >0.25% and CPIAUCSL yoy >2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: HOUST below 950.0 indicates housing market contraction, reducing consumer confidence and spending to cause negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in >60% of periods when HOUST < 950.0.
